scope_statement: The bursae around the knee and their role.
source_note: No sources were retrieved. The generation environment had no access to PubMed, Cochrane, the knowledge base or any textbook. The Tier 1 source minimum is NOT met and this draft would not pass Tier 1 in the deployed pipeline.
claims_needing_verification: Bursae are synovium lined sacs at sites of friction, responding to irritation with fluid.
The suprapatellar bursa communicates with the joint in most adults.
Bursal swelling is circumscribed with preserved movement; an effusion is diffuse and restricts flexion.
Septic bursitis is distinct from septic arthritis and differs in urgency and treatment.
A popliteal cyst usually communicates with the joint and reflects intra-articular pathology.
